title: Exact matched partitions on an invariant set with representatives unique modulo sign
statement: Let G = SL₂(ℤ) act canonically on the upper half-plane ℍ with its Borel measurable structure. Let Δ ≤ G contain −I, and let E,F,X ⊆ ℍ be measurable. Assume γz ∈ X if and only if z ∈ X for every γ ∈ Δ and z ∈ ℍ. Assume also that, for each S equal to E or F and every z ∈ X, there exists r ∈ Δ such that rz ∈ S and every δ ∈ Δ with δz ∈ S satisfies δ = r or δ = −r. Then there exist families A,B : Δ → Set ℍ whose members are measurable, such that each family is pairwise disjoint, ⋃γ Aγ = E ∩ X, ⋃γ Bγ = F ∩ X, and the image of Aγ under z ↦ γ⁻¹z is exactly Bγ for every γ ∈ Δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (E F X : Set UpperHalfPlane), (-1 : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ∈ Δ → MeasurableSet E → MeasurableSet F → MeasurableSet X → (∀ (γ : Δ) (z : UpperHalfPlane), (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) • z ∈ X ↔ z ∈ X) → (∀ S : Set UpperHalfPlane, (S = E ∨ S = F) → ∀ z ∈ X, ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ Δ ∧ γ • z ∈ S ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ Δ → δ • z ∈ S → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → ∃ A B : Δ → Set UpperHalfPlane, (∀ γ, MeasurableSet (A γ)) ∧ (∀ γ, MeasurableSet (B γ)) ∧ Pairwise (fun γ δ => Disjoint (A γ) (A δ)) ∧ Pairwise (fun γ δ => Disjoint (B γ) (B δ)) ∧ (⋃ γ, A γ) = E ∩ X ∧ (⋃ γ, B γ) = F ∩ X ∧ (∀ γ : Δ, (fun z : UpperHalfPlane => (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)⁻¹ • z) '' (A γ) = B γ)
